title: Aye Shahey Do Jahaan Khuda Haafez
body:
Aye shahey do jahaan khuda haafez
Aye mohammad ki jaan khuda haafez
<<DIVIDER>>
Humshabi-e-nabi Hussain kay laal
Akbar-e-naujawaan khuda haafez
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye shahey deen kay tashna lab yaawar
Asghar-e-bey zubaan khuda haafez
<<DIVIDER>>
Pheirnay waaley khushk houtoun par
Apni sookhi zabaan khuda haafez
<<DIVIDER>>
Paaye maal-e-gham-o-alam khasim
Jaao shabbar ki jaan khuda haafez
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye alamdaar-e-fauj aye Abbas
Aye Ali kay nashaan khuda haafez.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho chuki aaj khatm mehmaani
Shiyoun kay mehmaan khuda haafez.
